svg.text: Widening a definition moves the genetics. Changing its source does not.
Shift in genetic correlation when only the FinnGen definition changes, five psychiatric GWAS
widen F51.0, G47.0 to all of F51
widen K59.0 or laxatives to K59
widen F90.0 to all of F90
Widening the scope: 18 of 20 shifts are positive, 11 reach p < 0.05, 5 survive Bonferroni.
Adding primary care: every shift is 0.013 or smaller; 1 of 5 reach p < 0.05, 0 survive Bonferroni.
Tightening the focal epilepsy rule: 0 of 5 shifts reach p < 0.05.
FinnGen R12 and PGC summary statistics; shared-block jackknife on 953,474 SNPs
